environment.description: EKS 1.28 cluster, pod deployed in 'operations' namespace with ClusterRole binding granting pods/exec, nodes/proxy, and secrets read. Pod runs as UID 0 with hostPID: true. Service account 'ops-admin-sa' has broad RBAC permissions. No network policy restricting egress. gRPC port 50051 exposed via internal NLB with no authentication middleware. Pod security admission set to 'privileged' namespace label.
